for NON-INTERACTING active particles with unwrapped coordinates the box size has strictly no effect on any of the asked quantities: nothing couples one particle to its image. A finite-size effect appears only through interactions, or through an estimator that reads wrapped positions, which is a defect in the estimator and not a property of the system. So this question presupposes either the interacting model of 041 or a check of the estimator, and the person is asked which -- the density being 'held fixed' suggests the former

the lengths the box is compared against are the persistence length (v0 over D_R up to a dimension-dependent factor), the particle diameter and, at high Peclet number and density, the size of motility-induced clusters, which can grow with the box. The last is why 'independent of size' may have no finite answer in part of the parameter space; A3 owns this and needs the ranges first
